description: Kind of tissue the sample is: Primary Tumor, Metastatic, Recurrent Tumor, Solid Tissue Normal, Primary Blood Derived Cancer (leukaemias), etc. The website's "Exclude Non-tumor" and the GTEx "Normal Tissue" / "Cell Line" labels use this column.
source: TCGA sample barcode (the two digits after the participant), decoded with the GDC sample type codes; Toil hub phenotype file

description: The two-digit sample type code of the TCGA barcode: 01 Primary Solid Tumor, 02 Recurrent Solid Tumor, 03 Primary Blood Derived Cancer (peripheral blood), 05 Additional New Primary, 06 Metastatic, 07 Additional Metastatic, 11 Solid Tissue Normal.
source: GDC sample type codes

description: The TCGA study (cancer type) the sample belongs to, by its four-letter code (BRCA = breast invasive carcinoma, LUAD = lung adenocarcinoma, ...). In the Toil collection the cohort is the disease or tissue name across TCGA, TARGET and GTEx.
source: TCGA project codes; the Toil "disease" field

description: The same TCGA study code as "cohort" (kept under its original name).
source: TCGA project codes

description: The cohort spelled out in words (lower case), e.g. "breast invasive carcinoma".
source: TCGA project names

description: The participant barcode (TCGA-XX-XXXX): all samples of one patient share it. A patient can have more than one sample (a tumour and its matched normal, a primary and a metastasis).
source: TCGA barcode

description: Age in years when the cancer was first diagnosed by pathology.
source: TCGA-CDR (Liu et al., Cell 2018)

description: Sex recorded in the clinical record (MALE / FEMALE).
source: TCGA-CDR; Toil hub phenotype file

description: Self-reported race, in the US census categories used by TCGA.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: AJCC pathologic stage (Stage I to IV with sub-stages) from the surgical specimen. Not recorded for cancers that are not staged this way (e.g. gliomas, leukaemias).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Clinical stage (before surgery; FIGO stage for gynaecological cancers), recorded for the cancer types that stage clinically.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Histological type of the tumour as written in the pathology report (e.g. "Infiltrating Ductal Carcinoma", "Lung Adenocarcinoma Mixed Subtype").
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Tumour grade G1 (well differentiated) to G4 (undifferentiated); GX = cannot be assessed; GB = borderline (ovarian). Recorded only for the cancer types that grade tumours.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Calendar year of the initial pathological diagnosis.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Menopausal status at diagnosis (pre, peri, post, indeterminate), for breast and gynaecological cancers.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from birth to the initial diagnosis, as a negative number (so -20000 is about 55 years old). Ages over 90 are capped by TCGA for privacy.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Alive or Dead at the last follow-up.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Whether the patient had evidence of tumour at the last follow-up (WITH TUMOR / TUMOR FREE). Used by the CDR to decide disease-specific deaths and progression events.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to the last follow-up contact (for living patients).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to death (for deceased patients).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Recorded cause of death where known (the cancer, another malignancy, a non-malignant disease).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Kind of the new tumour event(s) after the initial treatment: locoregional recurrence, distant metastasis, new primary tumour, progression of disease, biochemical evidence of disease. Several events are joined with "|".
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Site (organ) of the new tumour event(s), "|"-separated when there were several.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Free text for a site not in the standard list.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to the first new tumour event.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Response to the first course of treatment: Complete Remission/Response, Partial Remission/Response, Stable Disease, Progressive Disease, Persistent Disease, etc. Complete remission is one of the ways a patient is counted as disease-free for the DFI endpoint.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Surgical resection margins: Negative (no tumour at the margin), Close, or Positive (tumour at the margin).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Residual tumour after surgery: R0 none, R1 microscopic, R2 macroscopic, RX cannot be assessed. R0 is one of the ways a patient is counted as disease-free for the DFI endpoint.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Overall survival event: 1 = died (any cause), 0 = alive at last contact (censored). Pair with OS.time.
source: TCGA-CDR: time from the initial diagnosis to death from any cause, or to the last contact

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to death or to the last contact (the follow-up time for OS).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Disease-specific survival event: 1 = died of the cancer (died with tumour, or the cause of death was the cancer), 0 = alive or died of something else (censored). An approximation: the cause of death is not always verified. Pair with DSS.time.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to death or to the last contact (the follow-up time for DSS).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Disease-free interval event, for patients who became disease-free after the initial treatment (complete remission, no residual tumour): 1 = a new tumour event (locoregional recurrence, distant metastasis, new primary tumour in the same organ) or death from the cancer, 0 = none of these (censored; a new primary in another organ censors). Patients who were never disease-free (e.g. stage IV) have no DFI. Pair with DFI.time.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to the first new tumour event, death, or the last contact (the follow-up time for DFI).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Progression-free interval event: 1 = a new tumour event (progression, locoregional recurrence, distant metastasis, new primary tumour) or death with tumour, 0 = alive without such an event or died without tumour (censored). The CDR's recommended endpoint for most cancer types (follow-up is shorter than for OS, so there are more events). Not meaningful for LAML and DLBC. Pair with PFI.time.
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Days from the initial diagnosis to the first new tumour event, death, or the last contact (the follow-up time for PFI).
source: TCGA-CDR

description: Redacted marks a case TCGA withdrew after publication (e.g. a consent or identity problem); its clinical data should not be used. Empty for all other patients.
source: TCGA-CDR
